column1: Note 1:Reference measurement channel RC.4 TDD according to Table A.4-1 with one/two sided dynamic OCNG Pattern OP.1/OP.2 TDD as described in Annex A.5.2.1/A.5.2.2.Note 2:For each test, the minimum requirements shall be fulfilled for at least one of the two SNR(s) and the respective wanted signal input level.Note 3:To avoid collisions between CQI reports and HARQ-ACK it is necessary to report both on PUSCH instead of PUCCH.
